title: Subscription SaaS Starter
description: A reusable subscription app base — auth, checkout, and webhook-driven billing — configured as one branded paid product.

caseStudy.problem: To validate a paid-product idea quickly, I needed a repeatable subscription base — auth, checkout, and billing state — instead of rebuilding payments from scratch every time.
caseStudy.built: A forked subscription starter configured for a single product: sign-up and sign-in, a card + local-payment checkout flow, webhook-driven billing state, and provider credentials set outside application code.
caseStudy.result: Shortened the path from idea to a testable paid product, with subscription state driven by server-side webhooks rather than ad-hoc client checks.
